name: com.testplay.bridge
description: Warm-editor bridge for the TestPlay Runner CLI (testplay). DORMANT by default: it activates only when opted in via the TESTPLAY_BRIDGE_ENABLE=1 environment variable or a .testplay/bridge/ENABLE sentinel file, and never in batchmode. When active, it runs EditMode tests in the already-open Editor via the TestRunnerApi and reports the same NUnit results.xml a cold batchmode run would produce, over a file-based protocol under <project>/.testplay/bridge/. This eliminates the shadow-workspace copy and the cold domain reload for agent/CI runs while preserving testplay's output contract.
